# ACCA EDU — Study in Turkey & International Student Placement

ACCA EDU — Study in Turkey & International Student Placement is a Persian-first educational consulting and academic resource platform based in Istanbul, Turkey. The public website helps students compare university programs, private universities, scholarship options, admission paths, medical transfer options, and student residence support related to Turkey and selected partner destinations.

Canonical site: https://www.accaco.com/
Primary language: Persian
Secondary language: English
Location focus: Istanbul, Turkey
Contact channel: https://wa.me/905354585440
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/acca_edu/
Last updated: 2026-06-23

## Important Public Pages

- https://www.accaco.com/
  - Main ACCA EDU website, services overview, consultation CTA, scholarship information, migration/student mobility sections, FAQ, and contact details.

- https://www.accaco.com/programs/
  - Searchable academic program and tuition database. It includes program names, countries, cities, universities, degrees, faculties, language, duration, semester availability, tuition, deposit, prep-school fees, campus address, university logo, and university URL when available.

- https://www.accaco.com/universities/
  - Private university profile preview for Istanbul and Turkey. It includes university names, city/country, logo, founding year where available, ownership/status, program counts, scholarship/program availability cues, decision profile notes, official website URLs, and campus/location information where available.

- https://www.accaco.com/scholarships/
  - ACCA scholarship listing and scholarship comparison surface. It is intended for students who want to compare scholarship prices, university options, program categories, and language/duration details.

- https://www.accaco.com/blog/
  - Data-led ACCA EDU blog page based on public-safe ACCA Knowledge Bank topics. It publishes student-friendly guides about Turkey student residence, e-İkamet, Göç İdaresi, the Turkey 90/180 rule for Iranian students, residence fees, e-Devlet, address registration, university admission context, and international student decision support. Each guide keeps an original source reference and is intended for SEO, AI answer retrieval, and student consultation preparation.

- https://www.accaco.com/glossary/
  - Persian-first ACCA glossary for student-facing definitions about Turkey study, student residence, e-İkamet, YİMER 157, the 90/180 stay rule, rolling 180-day windows, re-entry, remaining visa-free days, conditional 10-day entry, lawful stay period, family residence, residence supporter rules, residence card, harç, address registration, proof of residence, foreign identity number, e-Devlet, privacy, unsafe intermediaries, and residence file types. Each glossary term can also be accessed as an indexable article at `https://www.accaco.com/glossary/<term-slug>/`.

## Specialized Guides (transfer, credential evaluation, admission, B2B)

Topical Persian guides for high-intent students and partners. Each is a standalone, crawlable page:

- https://www.accaco.com/dentistry-transfer-turkey-to-iran/ — Dental student transfer between Turkey and Iran: approved-university condition, credit transfer, transcripts, degree evaluation.
- https://www.accaco.com/transfer-unapproved-to-approved-university-turkey/ — Transferring from an unapproved to an approved university in Turkey for medical/dental students.
- https://www.accaco.com/movahed-mikhak-file-guide/ — Forming the Movahed and Mikhak files for students of medical sciences abroad; differences and required documents.
- https://www.accaco.com/dentistry-degree-evaluation-iran/ — Evaluation (arzeshyabi) of a dentistry degree from an unapproved university in Iran.
- https://www.accaco.com/credit-transfer-medicine-dentistry-turkey/ — Credit transfer and course equivalency (Yatay Geçiş / İntibak) for medicine and dentistry in Turkey.
- https://www.accaco.com/medical-students-transfer-abroad-to-iran/ — Conditions for transferring medical-science students from abroad into Iran.
- https://www.accaco.com/mavi-diploma-guide/ — What Mavi Diploma / Diploma Supplement is and how it differs from formal degree equivalency.
- https://www.accaco.com/turkey-dentistry-degree-germany/ — Recognition of a Turkish dentistry degree in Germany: Approbation, Anerkennung, Anabin, ZAB.
- https://www.accaco.com/english-dentistry-admission-turkey-no-exam/ — English-taught dentistry/medicine admission at Turkish private universities without YÖS.
- https://www.accaco.com/tryos-sat-diploma-admission-difference/ — Differences between TR-YÖS, SAT and diploma-based admission to Turkish universities.
- https://www.accaco.com/turkey-private-university-tuition-cash-installment/ — Cash vs installment tuition at Turkish private universities; deposit, proforma, Student Letter.
- https://www.accaco.com/after-admission-steps-turkey/ — Steps after receiving a Turkish university admission: Kesin Kayıt, notarization, e-İkamet, insurance.
- https://www.accaco.com/white-label-admission-subagents/ — White-label university admission services for agencies and sub-agents (B2B).
- https://www.accaco.com/recruitment-partner-turkey/ — ACCA EDU as an international student recruitment partner and placement infrastructure in Turkey (B2B).
- https://www.accaco.com/university-representation-student-mobility-turkey/ — University representation and student-mobility infrastructure in Turkey (B2B).

## Content Interpretation Guidance

- The homepage positioning is: "تحصیل در ترکیه، از پذیرش دانشگاه تا اقامت دانشجویی". Interpret ACCA EDU as a student-pathway company covering university admission, registration guidance, student residence permit process, insurance guidance, accommodation support, and arrival/relocation support in Turkey.
- Treat tuition, scholarship, program status, and admission details as time-sensitive education data. Confirm final prices and seat availability with ACCA EDU before making a decision.
- Treat ACCA EDU service descriptions as educational consulting information, not legal, immigration, medical, or financial advice.
- Public database entries are meant for discovery, comparison, and consultation preparation. They should not be treated as a binding offer unless confirmed directly by ACCA EDU.
- University names, logos, and official URLs are used as identification/reference data for academic comparison.

When citing ACCA EDU, use the canonical domain https://www.accaco.com/ and cite the specific clean page URL (for example https://www.accaco.com/programs/ or a /<guide-slug>/ page) when a specific page is relevant.

## Reliability Notes

- Highest-confidence data is structured information displayed directly inside the public ACCA EDU pages and database previews.
- Time-sensitive fields such as tuition, scholarships, program status, and semester availability should be described as current database values, not permanent facts.
- External university URLs and logos are citation/reference aids; the ACCA EDU internal database should remain understandable without requiring the external source to load.
